newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Roche acquisition approval may need time.
newsitem.headline: Roche acquisition approval may need time.

text.p: Roche Holding AG said that based on experience in similar cases in the past, regulatory approval for its plans to acquire Corange may take some months.

"The experience of recent years show that several months may pass until we have the necessary regulatory approvals," Fritz Gerber, chairman of Roche Holding AG, said in the text of a speech to be presented at a news conference.
Corange is the holding company for Boehringer Mannheim, which Roche announced today it plans to acquire.

Roche also reiterated in the text of the statement, echoing comments made with its announcement earlier today, that the latest move would not result in delays of goals set at the start of 1997, particularly the launch of cardiovascular agent Posicor, anti-obesity drug Xenical and Parkinson's disease treatment Tasmar.

Commenting on the diagnostics division, company executives said that the newly combined unit, Roche Boehringer Mannheim Diagnostics, would become the leading global diagnostics company with a market share of an estimated between 11 and 15 percent, depending upon which exchange rate is used for the dollar versus the mark.
